Done — I built a complete playable browser game and placed it in `index.html` at the workspace root. It is currently served at:

http://localhost:3002

What’s in it:
- Neon sci-fi survival runner
- Collect 8 fragments
- Reach the gate to win
- Enemy waves, health/lives, time, pause, score/best tracking
- Keyboard + touch controls
- Start, win, lose, and pause states

Controls:
- Move: WASD / Arrow keys
- Burst/dash: Space / Shift
- Pause: Esc / P
- Mobile: touch joystick + dash button

Assumptions:
- I treated this as a compact single-page arcade game with no external art or backend, since the repo was effectively empty aside from the scaffolding.
- I used synthesized in-browser tones instead of external audio assets.

I also verified the latest screenshot at:
- `screenshots/check.jpg`
